name: v1
about: A voice that goes by the speaker's median pitch: `low` up to pitch[0] Hz, `high` from pitch[1] Hz, every number between them in a straight line along the logarithm of the pitch (pmvc.encoder's Decoder). `low` is CHIMERA's adult male with the epilarynx held narrow, as the fits to JVS's men had it on average (the one of their settings that moves the spectrum of the men's vowels); `high` is the voice fitted to a high-pitched speaker and chosen by ear (out/fit/voice-F2.json) on the body fitted to JVS's women on average, with a larger sinus and a glottis that closes a little more abruptly (half of what the women's recordings measure, the listener's choice).
